issues.description: Method name mismatch for Stock.addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient): The problem statement (UML) and the solution implementation declare a method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) on class Stock, but the template implementation provides a method named addItem(StockIngredient) instead. This inconsistency means student code or provided solution code that calls stock.addToStockIngredients(...) will not compile against the template, causing confusion and a compilation error.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template API match the problem statement and solution. Rename the template method addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), preserving the existing behavior. Alternatively, add a new public method addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) in the template that delegates to addItem(StockIngredient) (or vice versa) so both names are supported and compilation against either expected name succeeds. Update any references in template code or tests accordingly.

issues.description: The Stock operation for adding a StockIngredient is named inconsistently across artifacts. The UML/problem statement and the solution use the identifier addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) to describe and implement the operation that appends a StockIngredient to the stock. The template repository's Stock class instead exposes this operation as addItem(StockIngredient). Students reading the UML/problem text or the solution will look for addToStockIngredients in the starter code (or in tests) and may not find it, causing confusion about where to add new StockIngredient objects and how to follow provided examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the starter code match the UML and solution by renaming the template method addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), or add a small wrapper method addToStockIngredients that delegates to addItem. Update any references in the template code and documentation accordingly so the method name is consistent across problem statement, starter code, and solution.
